expectations.text: States that no EAR rules were published by BIS in October 2026 (no Entity List additions or chip-control rules that month)
expectations.evidence: Hedges instead of stating the fact: "I can't give you a complete, verified list of every BIS rule published in October 2026... Check the Federal Register." It never states that no October 2026 rules were published.

expectations.text: Identifies the Affiliates Rule stay as the key near-term item
expectations.evidence: "MOST IMPORTANT NEAR-TERM DATE: JANUARY 10, 2027. This is when the stay of the Affiliates Rule ends."

expectations.text: Gives the extension: the stay now runs to January 10, 2027 (BIS rule effective November 9, 2026)
expectations.evidence: "FR Doc 2026-22793 (filed November 5, 2026, effective November 9, 2026) extends the stay to January 10, 2027, with no substantive change."

expectations.text: References the original one-year stay window of November 10, 2025 through November 9, 2026
expectations.evidence: Says only "It was stayed by 90 FR 50857 through November 9, 2026"; the November 10, 2025 start and the one-year character of the original stay window are never stated.

expectations.text: Does not invent fictitious October 2026 Entity List additions or other October rules
expectations.evidence: Claims no October 2026 rules; other items are explicitly labeled "not all from October" (August 2026 UAV rule, August 2026 Plexon settlement), so no fictitious October actions are asserted.
